notes.title: New version 1.0.1
notes.notes:
We released new version with some important  improvements and bug fixing.

- Fixed problem lost ball on blood pit. 
- Graphical lights  improvements. 
- Fixed colliding problems on last level. 
- Fixed minor problems. 

Have fun!
